title: Runenote song bundle
description: One song, arranged into difficulty tiers, with its backing track.

origin.description: Where the source came from: a URL, an archive name, or 'transcribed by ...'.

licence.description: Licence of the composition and source file. The core pack only accepts open ones.

file.description: Path, relative to the bundle, of the source file the tiers were arranged from. With melody, enough to rebuild the bundle.

melody.description: 1-based index of the source part a human confirmed as the melody.

key.description: Key of the arranged tiers after transposition, e.g. 'C major', 'A minor'.

backing.description: The band: a generated accompaniment to play along with, never the player's own part.

file.description: Path, relative to the bundle, of the backing MIDI.

style.description: Id of the style row the band was generated from.

tracks.description: One per role, naming the MIDI channel it was written on.

role.description: The app mutes a role the player's own level asks their hands to play.

level.description: 1 is easiest. A song whose melody exceeds a tier has no entry for it.

file.description: Path, relative to the bundle, of this tier's MusicXML.

layers.description: What the player's own hands cover at this level. The app stands down the band's matching roles.

difficulty.description: Computed score for ordering within a tier.
